All day until I has to bounce for work, I got "You okay?"

"Leigh," I ask my partner, "could you please tell me what the hell has the bug up everyone's ass today?"

"Haven you heard?" she asks, "We've been attacked."

I'm gonna go make rounds. I'm in the last of the dorms when I look on TV to see footage of the WTC Towers smoking worse than I am that night. I tap one of the inmates on the shoulder and say, "What movie is this?"
